description: Fetches institutional profiles, exhibition records, and page content from the Alfried Krupp von Bohlen und Halbach Foundation website (www.krupp-stiftung.de).

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - list_institutions: Lists all foundation institutions with names and URLs; 参数: 无; 必填: 无
  - get_institution: Gets detailed profile of a specific institution; requires slug or url; 参数: slug, url; 必填: 无
  - get_exhibition: Gets the Krupp Historical Exhibition content with room-by-room details; 参数: 无; 必填: 无
  - get_page: Gets content from any page on the site; requires url; 参数: url; 必填: url

slug.description: Institution slug (URL path segment) for get_institution. Example: "thyssenkrupp-ag" for /en/institutionen/thyssenkrupp-ag/

url.description: Full URL for get_institution or get_page functions. Must be from www.krupp-stiftung.de domain.
